CLAIM FORMS

Resolution (CIRP)

  • CIRP Form B - Proof of claim by OC except WE
  • CIRP Form C - Proof of claim by Financial Creditor
  • CIRP Form CA - Proof of claim by FC in a Class
  • CIRP Form D - Proof of claim by WE
  • CIRP Form E - Proof of claim by AR to WE
  • CIRP Form F - Proof of claim by Creditors except FC OC

Fast Track Resolution (CIFTP)

  • CIFTP Form B - Proof of claim by OC except WE
  • CIFTP Form C - Proof of claim by FC
  • CIFTP Form D - Proof of claim by WE
  • CIFTP Form E - Proof of claim by AR to WE
  • CIFTP Form F - Proof of claim by Creditors except FC OC

Liquidation (CILP)

  • CILP Form B - Proof of claim
  • CILP Form C - Submission of claim by financial creditor
  • CILP Form D - Proof of claim by workman or employee
  • CILP Form E - Proof of claim by workman or employee by AR
  • CILP Form F - Submission of claim by creditors
  • CILP Form G - Submission of claim by creditors

Voluntary Liquidation (CIVLP)

  • CIVLP Form B - Proof of claim
  • CIVLP Form C - Submission of claim by financial creditor
  • CIVLP Form D - Proof of claim by workman or employee
  • CIVLP Form E - Proof of claim by workman or employee by AR
  • CIVLP Form F - Submission of claim by creditors
